name: Resource manifest and integrity verification
purpose: Fail closed when a mutable public file or local input differs from the audited resource
input_contract: TSV manifest with URL local filename byte count and SHA256; three local resources
output_contract: Verified resource records or a non-zero failure before parsing
notes: The public GEO matrix was replaced in place in 2026, making per-file integrity evidence necessary.

name: GEO probe annotation clinical parsing and identity linkage
purpose: Build a patient-level expression-survival input without manual joins
input_contract: GSE62254 gzipped series matrix; GPL570 annotation; ACRG xlsx sheet
output_contract: 300-row patient source table; 19-probe mapping; exact ID audit
notes: Clinical endpoints are absent from the GEO matrix and must be linked from the official article supplement by GEO ID.

name: Locked NRRS scoring survival analysis and figure
purpose: Apply the published coefficients under explicit reconstructed preprocessing and quantify mapping sensitivity
input_contract: 300 patients; eight gene expression columns; OS months and 0/1 death
output_contract: NRRS source table; summary estimates; mapping sensitivity; noninteractive KM PNG
notes: Claim ceiling is a retrospective reconstruction in a development-exposed cohort.
